gem_guidance.text: In this phase, we get a new wand from the Badge of Justice vendor: Carved Witch Doctor's Stick . This can be combined with a Great Lionseye to replace previous spell hit alternatives. If you're already hit capped, then you can equip it with a Runed Crimson Spinel for extra raw damage. It's also possible to use a Glowing Shadowsong Amethyst to achieve the meta gem bonus if needed. Due to the ease of getting this wand, along with the flexibility of gemming, there are no other alternatives worth considering.
